name: Band Single-Leg Reverse Calf Raise
steps: Sit on the floor facing a low band anchor with one leg extended straight and the band looped securely across the top of that forefoot.
Slide back slightly until the band pulls your toes gently forward into light tension.
Keep your heel resting on the floor and pull your toes smoothly back toward your shin against the band.
Point your foot slowly back toward the anchor, then switch legs after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your kneecap pointing straight upward rather than rotating your whole leg.
Move strictly through your ankle joint to isolate the front of your shin.
